The whole Peer to Peer update kerfuffle is overblown. The default setting is that it only does the peer to peer sharing with computers on your network. This means that if you have 5 windows 10 machines on your network that you will only have to download an update once instead of 5 times. So the default setting will actually reduce your bandwidth usage. It doesn't share with the internet unless you go in and change the settings.

(Edit) It seems like this is a change to the original default, but on my install the default was to only share with PCs on the local network.
